units.english: Became trapped in a strange region after entering a system my jump drive could not return from.
units.italian: Sono rimasto intrappolato in una regione sconosciuta dopo essere entrato in un sistema da cui il mio motore di salto non può riportarmi indietro.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Lost in Twilight|As soon as you jump into the system, you notice something is wrong. The characteristic plasma of your jump drive fades unnaturally quickly, and as you check your ship's systems, you notice its temperature is somehow much lower than normal. Your computer indicates that the system you came from is out of range, and that you cannot jump back to it. It appears you are stuck in this region for now. If you didn't bring a ramscoop, you may wish to reload a previous save and install one before returning.|25|0

Your computer indicates that the system you came from is out of range, and that you cannot jump back to it. It appears you are stuck in this region for now. If you didn't bring a ramscoop, you may wish to reload a previous save and install one before returning.
units.italian: Appena salti nel sistema ti accorgi che qualcosa non va. Il plasma caratteristico del motore di salto svanisce con una rapidità innaturale e, mentre controlli i sistemi della nave, noti che la temperatura è in qualche modo molto più bassa del normale. Il computer indica che il sistema da cui sei arrivato è fuori portata e che non puoi saltarci indietro. A quanto pare, per ora sei bloccato in questa regione. Se non hai portato un ramscoop, forse conviene ricaricare un salvataggio precedente e installarne uno prima di tornare.

units.id: mission:Avgi: First Contact|description|36|0
units.english: Accompany the alien ship to the destination marked on your map.
units.italian: Accompagna la nave aliena fino alla destinazione segnata sulla mappa.

units.id: mission:Avgi: First Contact|The first thing you notice about this Earth-like world is the utter devastation in orbit. Your ship's sensors pick up the remains of what appear to be dozens of wrecked stations and countless destroyed satellites, forming a large swath of debris scattered in various orbits. A few larger objects are mostly intact, but lifeless, with no signal emissions or heat signatures. As your ship touches the upper atmosphere, you can see, even with your naked eye, glittering fragments of an immensely long tether slowly spinning in orbit.|57|0
units.english: The first thing you notice about this Earth-like world is the utter devastation in orbit. Your ship's sensors pick up the remains of what appear to be dozens of wrecked stations and countless destroyed satellites, forming a large swath of debris scattered in various orbits. A few larger objects are mostly intact, but lifeless, with no signal emissions or heat signatures. As your ship touches the upper atmosphere, you can see, even with your naked eye, glittering fragments of an immensely long tether slowly spinning in orbit.
units.italian: La prima cosa che noti di questo mondo simile alla Terra è la devastazione assoluta in orbita. I sensori della nave captano i resti di quella che sembra essere una dozzina di stazioni distrutte e di innumerevoli satelliti annientati, che formano un'ampia fascia di detriti sparsi su orbite diverse. Alcuni oggetti più grandi sono in gran parte intatti, ma senza vita, senza emissioni di segnale né firme termiche. Quando la nave tocca gli strati superiori dell'atmosfera, riesci a vedere anche a occhio nudo i frammenti scintillanti di una fune lunghissima che ruota lentamente in orbita.

units.id: mission:Avgi: First Contact|	Your observations are interrupted by a blared warning from your console. You barely manage to yank your ship aside as a bright trail of plasma nearly clips you, the wake of a hypervelocity projectile fired from the ground. Clearly, someone is still alive down there, despite the destruction in orbit. Proceeding could be dangerous if your ship isn't able to withstand a direct hit from those planetary defense batteries.|58|0
units.english: Your observations are interrupted by a blared warning from your console. You barely manage to yank your ship aside as a bright trail of plasma nearly clips you, the wake of a hypervelocity projectile fired from the ground. Clearly, someone is still alive down there, despite the destruction in orbit. Proceeding could be dangerous if your ship isn't able to withstand a direct hit from those planetary defense batteries.
units.italian: Le tue osservazioni sono interrotte dall'ululato di un allarme della console. Riesci a malapena a scartare la nave mentre una scia luminosa di plasma ti sfiora: è la scia di un proiettile iperveloce sparato da terra. Evidentemente laggiù qualcuno è ancora vivo, nonostante la distruzione in orbita. Proseguire potrebbe essere pericoloso se la nave non è in grado di reggere un colpo diretto di quelle batterie di difesa planetaria.

Quando rilevi il lancio di un numero decisamente irragionevole di missili, decidi che tornare in orbita è più sicuro.

units.id: mission:Avgi: First Contact|While this world looks presently unsettled, you can clearly make out signs that it has been explored, and even exploited, by an alien civilization. However, the signs also show that something disastrous happened here. Ruined satellites litter low orbit, and you can detect the broken remnants of surface outposts smeared across the land below. You take the <ship> in for a close pass over one of the structures, and can see small craters and patches of glassed terrain scattered around it.|113|0
units.english: While this world looks presently unsettled, you can clearly make out signs that it has been explored, and even exploited, by an alien civilization. However, the signs also show that something disastrous happened here. Ruined satellites litter low orbit, and you can detect the broken remnants of surface outposts smeared across the land below. You take the <ship> in for a close pass over one of the structures, and can see small craters and patches of glassed terrain scattered around it.
units.italian: Per quanto questo mondo appaia oggi disabitato, si distinguono chiaramente i segni di una civiltà aliena che lo ha esplorato e persino sfruttato. Ma gli stessi segni mostrano che qui è successo qualcosa di disastroso. Detriti di satelliti in rovina costellano l'orbita bassa e si rilevano i resti spezzati di avamposti di superficie sparsi sulla terra sottostante. Porti la <ship> a passare radente sopra una delle strutture e vedi piccoli crateri e chiazze di terreno vetrificato sparsi intorno.

units.id: mission:Avgi: First Contact|	Back in orbit, you are startled when another ship appears over the horizon on an intercept trajectory with you. It doesn't look like any other ship you've seen before, appearing more than a little ungainly compared to the sleeker human ships you're accustomed to. You aren't sure whether it belongs to the same species that inhabits this space, or an entirely different one, but it at least definitely isn't similar to the hostile ships that seem to infest this star cluster.|117|0
units.english: Back in orbit, you are startled when another ship appears over the horizon on an intercept trajectory with you. It doesn't look like any other ship you've seen before, appearing more than a little ungainly compared to the sleeker human ships you're accustomed to. You aren't sure whether it belongs to the same species that inhabits this space, or an entirely different one, but it at least definitely isn't similar to the hostile ships that seem to infest this star cluster.
units.italian: Di nuovo in orbita, sussulti quando un'altra nave compare oltre l'orizzonte su una traiettoria d'intercettazione. Non somiglia a nessuna nave che tu abbia mai visto: al confronto delle navi umane più slanciate a cui sei abituato è decisamente goffa. Non sai se appartenga alla stessa specie che abita questo spazio o a una del tutto diversa, ma di certo non assomiglia alle navi ostili che sembrano infestare questo ammasso stellare.

units.id: mission:Avgi: First Contact|This alien station has certainly seen better days. While the bulk of the structure is still intact, avoiding the fate of whatever became the debris fields you have seen elsewhere, the hull is scored and chipped by what appears to be powerful weapons fire. The station's systems all seem to be powered down, as you can detect no emissions of light or heat. Without expecting to find anyone or anything alive, you maneuver near what you think is an open docking bay.|127|0
units.english: This alien station has certainly seen better days. While the bulk of the structure is still intact, avoiding the fate of whatever became the debris fields you have seen elsewhere, the hull is scored and chipped by what appears to be powerful weapons fire. The station's systems all seem to be powered down, as you can detect no emissions of light or heat. Without expecting to find anyone or anything alive, you maneuver near what you think is an open docking bay.
units.italian: Questa stazione aliena ha certamente conosciuto giorni migliori. La struttura è in gran parte intatta - ha evitato il destino di ciò che ha prodotto i campi di detriti visti altrove - ma lo scafo è segnato e scheggiato da quello che sembra il fuoco di armi potenti. I sistemi della stazione paiono tutti spenti: non rilevi emissioni di luce né di calore. Senza aspettarti di trovare qualcuno o qualcosa di vivo, ti avvicini a quello che ti sembra un portello di attracco aperto.

units.id: mission:Avgi: First Contact|	Just as the <ship> pulls alongside the "docking bay," you spot what looks like a ship tucked away inside. It is like no ship you have ever seen before, appearing more than a little ungainly compared to the sleeker human ships you're accustomed to. You aren't sure whether it belongs to the same species that inhabits this space, or an entirely different one, but it at least definitely isn't similar to the hostile ships that seem to infest this star cluster. What's more, its reactor is powered up and it seems to have an active shield matrix. It appears someone is indeed home.|128|0
units.english: Just as the <ship> pulls alongside the "docking bay," you spot what looks like a ship tucked away inside. It is like no ship you have ever seen before, appearing more than a little ungainly compared to the sleeker human ships you're accustomed to. You aren't sure whether it belongs to the same species that inhabits this space, or an entirely different one, but it at least definitely isn't similar to the hostile ships that seem to infest this star cluster. What's more, its reactor is powered up and it seems to have an active shield matrix. It appears someone is indeed home.
units.italian: Proprio mentre la <ship> si affianca al "portello di attracco", scorgi quella che sembra una nave nascosta là dentro. È come nessuna nave tu abbia mai visto: al confronto delle navi umane più slanciate a cui sei abituato è decisamente goffa. Non sai se appartenga alla stessa specie che abita questo spazio o a una del tutto diversa, ma di certo non assomiglia alle navi ostili che sembrano infestare questo ammasso stellare. In più, il suo reattore è acceso e sembra avere una matrice di scudi attiva. Evidentemente qualcuno è davvero in casa.

units.id: mission:Avgi: First Contact|	You aren't quite sure how to proceed in communicating with a completely unknown species, but you transmit a standard hail, if only to assure the alien vessel that you're trying to signal it.|138|0

units.italian: Non sai bene come procedere nel comunicare con una specie del tutto sconosciuta, ma trasmetti un saluto standard, se non altro per far capire alla nave aliena che stai cercando di segnalarle qualcosa.

units.id: mission:Avgi: First Contact|	To your shock, however, the alien vessel responds after only a few minutes, not only in the same frequency band, but with an encoding your ship's computer is able to interpret: a standard human data format, similar to the one you've just sent. Either these aliens have an astonishing ability to decipher transmissions, or they have somehow encountered humanity before.|139|0
units.english: To your shock, however, the alien vessel responds after only a few minutes, not only in the same frequency band, but with an encoding your ship's computer is able to interpret: a standard human data format, similar to the one you've just sent. Either these aliens have an astonishing ability to decipher transmissions, or they have somehow encountered humanity before.
units.italian: Con tuo sconcerto, però, la nave aliena risponde dopo pochi minuti, non solo sulla stessa banda di frequenza, ma con una codifica che il computer di bordo è in grado di interpretare: un formato dati umano standard, simile a quello che hai appena inviato. O questi alieni hanno una capacità sbalorditiva di decifrare le trasmissioni, o hanno già incontrato l'umanità in qualche modo.

units.english: The message is short and direct:
units.italian: Il messaggio è breve e diretto:

units.id: mission:Avgi: First Contact|	You can't expect a new alien species to be able to decode your transmissions, let alone understand your language, so you transmit a short list of prime numbers via simple amplitude modulated signals, if only to assure the alien vessel that you're attempting to communicate.|144|0
units.english: You can't expect a new alien species to be able to decode your transmissions, let alone understand your language, so you transmit a short list of prime numbers via simple amplitude modulated signals, if only to assure the alien vessel that you're attempting to communicate.
units.italian: Non puoi aspettarti che una specie aliena appena incontrata sappia decodificare le tue trasmissioni, figurarsi capire la tua lingua; così trasmetti un breve elenco di numeri primi con semplici segnali in modulazione di ampiezza, se non altro per far capire alla nave aliena che stai tentando di comunicare.

units.id: mission:Avgi: First Contact|	To your shock, however, the alien vessel interrupts you just as you send the number "37," with a transmission not only in the same frequency band, but with an encoding your ship's computer is able to interpret: a standard human data format, similar to the one you've just sent. They must have somehow encountered humanity before.
units.italian: Con tuo sconcerto, però, la nave aliena ti interrompe proprio mentre invii il numero "37", con una trasmissione non solo sulla stessa banda di frequenza, ma con una codifica che il computer di bordo è in grado di interpretare: un formato dati umano standard, simile a quello che hai appena inviato. Devono aver già incontrato l'umanità in qualche modo.

units.english: Unsure of the intentions of the alien vessel, you remain silent. However, it seems the aliens have other intentions, as you shortly receive a transmission with an encoding your ship's computer is able to interpret, in a standard human data format. The message is short and direct:
units.italian: Incerto sulle intenzioni della nave aliena, resti in silenzio. Ma gli alieni sembrano avere altre intenzioni: poco dopo ricevi una trasmissione con una codifica che il computer di bordo è in grado di interpretare, in un formato dati umano standard. Il messaggio è breve e diretto:

units.id: mission:Avgi: First Contact|	"Salutations. I am of the Avgi. You human, question? Important. You will follow. This space, Twilight, not safe. You have hyperdrive, correct? Emphasis. Space we will travel is unstable, a maze. Follow closely and be careful."|153|0
units.english: "Salutations. I am of the Avgi. You human, question? Important. You will follow. This space, Twilight, not safe. You have hyperdrive, correct? Emphasis. Space we will travel is unstable, a maze. Follow closely and be careful."
units.italian: "Saluti. Io essere degli Avgi. Tu umano, domanda? Importante. Tu seguire. Questo spazio, Twilight, non sicuro. Tu avere hyperdrive, giusto? Enfasi. Spazio che attraverseremo instabile, un labirinto. Segui da vicino e attento."

units.id: mission:Avgi: First Contact|	The message includes an alien-looking star chart, with a trail of marked systems leading to a system far to the south. Something appears to have been lost in translation, as the systems are unmarked past a certain point and are instead labeled as "shrouded," whatever that means. Just as you are still processing first contact with an alien civilization, a group of the same ships that attacked you earlier jump into the system.|154|0
units.english: The message includes an alien-looking star chart, with a trail of marked systems leading to a system far to the south. Something appears to have been lost in translation, as the systems are unmarked past a certain point and are instead labeled as "shrouded," whatever that means. Just as you are still processing first contact with an alien civilization, a group of the same ships that attacked you earlier jump into the system.
units.italian: Il messaggio include una carta stellare dall'aspetto alieno, con una sequenza di sistemi segnati che porta a un sistema molto a sud. Qualcosa deve essersi perso nella traduzione: oltre un certo punto i sistemi non sono segnati e sono invece etichettati come "velati", qualunque cosa significhi. Proprio mentre stai ancora assimilando il primo contatto con una civiltà aliena, un gruppo delle stesse navi che ti hanno attaccato prima salta nel sistema.

units.id: mission:Avgi: First Contact|After a confusing journey through the winding hyperlanes, you finally arrive at the final system the alien marked on your map. You notice that your flight computer has failed to record the locations of most of the systems you passed through, probably due to the same anomaly that made your ship almost completely blind within the region. This region appears unaffected however, and your computer is able to chart its position as usual.|233|0
units.english: After a confusing journey through the winding hyperlanes, you finally arrive at the final system the alien marked on your map. You notice that your flight computer has failed to record the locations of most of the systems you passed through, probably due to the same anomaly that made your ship almost completely blind within the region. This region appears unaffected however, and your computer is able to chart its position as usual.
units.italian: Dopo un viaggio confuso lungo le ipervie sinuose, arrivi finalmente al sistema finale che l'alieno aveva segnato sulla mappa. Noti che il computer di volo non ha registrato la posizione della maggior parte dei sistemi attraversati, probabilmente a causa della stessa anomalia che ha reso la nave quasi completamente cieca dentro la regione. Questa regione invece sembra immune, e il computer riesce a calcolarne la posizione come al solito.

units.id: mission:Avgi: First Contact|	The alien ship pings you, indicating to follow as it flies towards what looks to be a large inhabited station in the system. Shaped like a circular disk, a large cutout in the center exposes hundreds of docking bays and what looks to be a spaceport. As you watch, a trio of sleek-looking fightercraft launch from the station and take up escort positions around you and the other alien ship you have followed all this way. You can only assume your escort is in communication with the station authorities.|234|0
units.english: The alien ship pings you, indicating to follow as it flies towards what looks to be a large inhabited station in the system. Shaped like a circular disk, a large cutout in the center exposes hundreds of docking bays and what looks to be a spaceport. As you watch, a trio of sleek-looking fightercraft launch from the station and take up escort positions around you and the other alien ship you have followed all this way. You can only assume your escort is in communication with the station authorities.
units.italian: La nave aliena ti invia un segnale e indica di seguirla mentre vola verso quella che sembra una grande stazione abitata del sistema. Ha la forma di un disco circolare, con un ampio incavo al centro che lascia scoperti centinaia di portelli di attracco e quello che sembra uno spazioporto. Mentre guardi, tre caccia slanciati decollano dalla stazione e prendono posizione di scorta intorno a te e all'altra nave aliena che hai seguito fin qui. Puoi solo supporre che la scorta sia in contatto con le autorità della stazione.

units.id: mission:Avgi: First Contact|dialog|237|0
units.english: The alien ship has been destroyed. If you want to continue the Avgi story, revert to the autosave or another earlier snapshot of the game.
units.italian: La nave aliena è stata distrutta. Se vuoi continuare la storia degli Avgi, torna al salvataggio automatico o a un'altra istantanea precedente della partita.

units.id: mission:Avgi: First Contact|dialog|240|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left the alien ship behind! Better depart and wait for them to properly introduce you.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro la nave aliena! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che si presentino come si deve.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|name|253|0
units.english: Humans Among the Avgi
units.italian: Umani tra gli Avgi

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|description|254|0
units.english: Visit the <destination>, where there is another human, Darius Calwell, stranded in Avgi space.
units.italian: Visita <destination>, dove c'è un altro umano, Darius Calwell, bloccato nello spazio degli Avgi.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|log|260|0
units.english: Met an alien species calling themselves the Avgi. Their home cluster appears infested with hostile ships from some unknown advanced civilization. Made contact with a scout ship and followed it back through a region south of Avgi space called the Tangled Shroud. Met with members of the Avgi government and made an agreement to let me purchase civilian technology.
units.italian: Ho incontrato una specie aliena che si fa chiamare Avgi. Il loro ammasso di origine sembra infestato da navi ostili di una civiltà avanzata sconosciuta. Sono entrato in contatto con una nave esploratrice e l'ho seguita attraverso una regione a sud dello spazio Avgi chiamata Tangled Shroud. Ho incontrato membri del governo Avgi e ho ottenuto un accordo per acquistare tecnologia civile.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|log|261|0
units.english: The Avgi are a young race of aliens resembling large, colorful dragonflies, which inhabit the Twilight Nebula in this part of the galaxy. After an overwhelming invasion by ships they call the Aberrant, most of their surviving spacecraft fled south through a maze-like region called the Tangled Shroud.
units.italian: Gli Avgi sono una giovane specie aliena che somiglia a grandi libellule variopinte e abita la Nebulosa di Twilight, in questa parte della galassia. Dopo un'invasione travolgente da parte di navi che chiamano Aberranti, la maggior parte delle loro astronavi sopravvissute è fuggita a sud attraverso una regione labirintica chiamata Tangled Shroud.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|log|262|0
units.english: The exiled Avgi seem to be led by a central government called the Consonance, but there are many who do not recognize this government.
units.italian: Gli Avgi in esilio sembrano guidati da un governo centrale chiamato Consonanza, ma molti non riconoscono questo governo.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|log|263|0
units.english: Asime is one of the three First Speakers of the Consonance Assembly. While reserved, Asime appears to be defensive about the decisions made by the Consonance in response to the Aberrant incursion.
units.italian: Asime è uno dei tre Primi Portavoce dell'Assemblea della Consonanza. Riservato, sembra sulla difensiva riguardo alle decisioni prese dalla Consonanza in risposta all'incursione degli Aberranti.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|log|264|0
units.english: Galano is one of the three First Speakers of the Consonance Assembly. He appears to be an elder statesman, with much pride for what the Avgi have accomplished.
units.italian: Galano è uno dei tre Primi Portavoce dell'Assemblea della Consonanza. Sembra un vecchio statista, molto orgoglioso di ciò che gli Avgi hanno realizzato.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|log|265|0
units.english: Prasinos is one of the three First Speakers of the Consonance Assembly. She seems to take a negative view on the Avgi history of division and fractiousness.
units.italian: Prasinos è uno dei tre Primi Portavoce dell'Assemblea della Consonanza. Sembra avere una visione negativa della storia Avgi di divisione e faziosità.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	Your companion speeds ahead, neatly pulling into one of the bays on the outer levels. When you attempt to follow, the fightercraft zip in front of you, herding you towards a different bay closer to the middle decks.|269|0
units.english: Your companion speeds ahead, neatly pulling into one of the bays on the outer levels. When you attempt to follow, the fightercraft zip in front of you, herding you towards a different bay closer to the middle decks.
units.italian: La tua compagna accelera e si infila con precisione in uno dei portelli dei livelli esterni. Quando provi a seguirla, i caccia ti sfrecciano davanti e ti indirizzano verso un portello diverso, più vicino ai ponti centrali.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	The docking bay is full of activity, and you finally get your first glimpse at this new species up close. They appear to be something analogous to an Earth dragonfly, or maybe closer to a damselfly - a meter and a half long on average, and with six limbs and wings. A group of them quickly close in around your ship as you finally land in a clear space, moving precisely. These aliens have clearly been expecting you.|270|0
units.english: The docking bay is full of activity, and you finally get your first glimpse at this new species up close. They appear to be something analogous to an Earth dragonfly, or maybe closer to a damselfly - a meter and a half long on average, and with six limbs and wings. A group of them quickly close in around your ship as you finally land in a clear space, moving precisely. These aliens have clearly been expecting you.
units.italian: Il portello di attracco è pieno di attività e finalmente vedi da vicino questa nuova specie. Sembrano qualcosa di analogo a una libellula terrestre, o forse più simili a una damigella - un metro e mezzo di lunghezza in media, con sei arti e ali. Mentre atterri in uno spazio libero, un gruppo si stringe rapidamente intorno alla nave, muovendosi con precisione. Questi alieni ti stavano chiaramente aspettando.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	None of the aliens look to be armed, but are arrayed around your ship in a clearly defensive circular pattern, both on foot and flitting about in the air. Some of them look to be wearing some kind of body armor, but they don't seem to be carrying any obvious weapons. As you step out of the <ship>, noticing the lighter gravity, a small group quickly moves forward to meet you.|271|0
units.english: None of the aliens look to be armed, but are arrayed around your ship in a clearly defensive circular pattern, both on foot and flitting about in the air. Some of them look to be wearing some kind of body armor, but they don't seem to be carrying any obvious weapons. As you step out of the <ship>, noticing the lighter gravity, a small group quickly moves forward to meet you.
units.italian: Nessuno degli alieni sembra armato, ma sono disposti intorno alla nave in uno schieramento circolare chiaramente difensivo, sia a piedi sia svolazzando in aria. Alcuni indossano una sorta di armatura, ma non sembrano portare armi visibili. Quando esci dalla <ship> e noti la gravità più leggera, un piccolo gruppo avanza rapidamente per incontrarti.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"Hello, I'm Captain <first> <last>."|273|0
units.english: "Hello, I'm Captain <first> <last>."
units.italian: "Salve, sono il capitano <first> <last>."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"I come in peace."|275|0
units.english: "I come in peace."
units.italian: "Vengo in pace."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"Take me to your leader."|277|0
units.english: "Take me to your leader."
units.italian: "Portami dal vostro capo."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	(Shoot them.)|279|0
units.english: (Shoot them.)
units.italian: (Sparagli.)

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	You draw your sidearm and begin firing at the group of aliens, who scatter in all directions. Your first shot glances off alien body armor, but your second burns a hole in a wing, sending the alien tumbling. You have little time to celebrate your short-lived victory, however, before a flash of unfathomably bright blue-green light turns you into a rapidly expanding cloud of hot vapor.|281|0
units.english: You draw your sidearm and begin firing at the group of aliens, who scatter in all directions. Your first shot glances off alien body armor, but your second burns a hole in a wing, sending the alien tumbling. You have little time to celebrate your short-lived victory, however, before a flash of unfathomably bright blue-green light turns you into a rapidly expanding cloud of hot vapor.
units.italian: Estrai l'arma da fianco e apri il fuoco sul gruppo di alieni, che si disperde in ogni direzione. Il primo colpo rimbalza su un'armatura, ma il secondo brucia un foro in un'ala e l'alieno precipita. Hai poco tempo per festeggiare la tua effimera vittoria: un lampo di luce blu-verde di una luminosità incomprensibile ti trasforma in una nube in rapida espansione di vapore incandescente.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	The aliens hum and chirp excitedly amongst themselves, the sound reminding you of a string instrument. You notice they seem to produce sounds not from any particular vocal organs, but by rubbing their forearms or legs together akin to a cricket. One of the aliens, with a cream-colored body, seems to hush the others, flaring their wings out before returning them to a folded position on their back. They then raise a curved, black instrument reminiscent of a violin bow, drawing it over one of their forelimbs for a moment before the device begins to speak in a synthetic, vaguely masculine voice.|285|0
units.english: The aliens hum and chirp excitedly amongst themselves, the sound reminding you of a string instrument. You notice they seem to produce sounds not from any particular vocal organs, but by rubbing their forearms or legs together akin to a cricket. One of the aliens, with a cream-colored body, seems to hush the others, flaring their wings out before returning them to a folded position on their back. They then raise a curved, black instrument reminiscent of a violin bow, drawing it over one of their forelimbs for a moment before the device begins to speak in a synthetic, vaguely masculine voice.
units.italian: Gli alieni ronzano e cinguettano eccitati tra loro, e il suono ricorda uno strumento a corde. Ti accorgi che non producono i suoni con organi vocali, ma strofinando gli avambracci o le zampe come un grillo. Uno degli alieni, dal corpo color crema, sembra zittire gli altri, aprendo le ali e poi ripiegandole sul dorso. Poi solleva un archetto nero e curvo, simile all'archetto di un violino, e lo passa su uno dei suoi arti anteriori; dopo un istante il dispositivo comincia a parlare con una voce sintetica, vagamente maschile.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"Invitation. Welcome, Captain <first> <last>. I am Lait of the Avgi, the one with whom you spoke earlier. I would show you to our leaders to discuss your arrival to our space."|286|0
units.english: "Invitation. Welcome, Captain <first> <last>. I am Lait of the Avgi, the one with whom you spoke earlier. I would show you to our leaders to discuss your arrival to our space."
units.italian: "Invito. Benvenuto, capitano <first> <last>. Sono Lait degli Avgi, colui con cui hai parlato prima. Ti condurrei dai nostri capi per discutere del tuo arrivo nel nostro spazio."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	(Follow the aliens.)|288|0
units.english: (Follow the aliens.)
units.italian: (Segui gli alieni.)

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"How can you speak my language?"|290|0
units.english: "How can you speak my language?"
units.italian: "Come fate a parlare la mia lingua?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"Who are those hostile aliens back toward the north?"|291|0
units.english: "Who are those hostile aliens back toward the north?"
units.italian: "Chi sono quegli alieni ostili verso nord?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"Will you tell me about your civilization?"|292|0
units.english: "Will you tell me about your civilization?"
units.italian: "Mi parlerete della vostra civiltà?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"Reassurance. All of your questions will be answered in time, Captain <last>. Please, now follow."|294|0
units.english: "Reassurance. All of your questions will be answered in time, Captain <last>. Please, now follow."
units.italian: "Rassicurazione. Tutte le tue domande avranno risposta a tempo debito, capitano <last>. Ora segui, per favore."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	You are led through the hangar, an entourage of guards separating you from curious onlookers - pilots, mechanics, or soldiers, you aren't sure. It's a bit awkward to be corralled by a group of people whose height barely comes past your knees, but you allow yourself to be escorted nonetheless. After exiting through a downward sloping ramp set in the floor, you then follow a long passageway that seems to perpetually curve upwards. You're reminded of older space stations, ones that relied on spin gravity before gravity plating became commonplace. Surprisingly, despite the short stature of your hosts, the halls and doorways seem to be more than capable of accommodating your height, a feature that makes more sense after you see multiple instances of the aliens making their way in the air, rather than on foot.|297|0
units.english: You are led through the hangar, an entourage of guards separating you from curious onlookers - pilots, mechanics, or soldiers, you aren't sure. It's a bit awkward to be corralled by a group of people whose height barely comes past your knees, but you allow yourself to be escorted nonetheless. After exiting through a downward sloping ramp set in the floor, you then follow a long passageway that seems to perpetually curve upwards. You're reminded of older space stations, ones that relied on spin gravity before gravity plating became commonplace. Surprisingly, despite the short stature of your hosts, the halls and doorways seem to be more than capable of accommodating your height, a feature that makes more sense after you see multiple instances of the aliens making their way in the air, rather than on foot.
units.italian: Sei condotto attraverso l'hangar, con un seguito di guardie che ti separa dai curiosi - piloti, meccanici o soldati, non sapresti dire. È un po' imbarazzante essere scortato da gente la cui altezza arriva a malapena alle tue ginocchia, ma ti lasci accompagnare lo stesso. Dopo essere uscito da una rampa che scende nel pavimento, segui un lungo corridoio che sembra curvarsi perpetuamente verso l'alto. Ti vengono in mente le vecchie stazioni spaziali, quelle che si affidavano alla gravità di rotazione prima che le piastre gravitazionali diventassero comuni. Sorprendentemente, nonostante la bassa statura dei tuoi ospiti, i corridoi e le porte sembrano ampiamente in grado di accogliere la tua altezza: una cosa che ha più senso dopo che hai visto gli alieni spostarsi in volo, invece che a piedi, più volte.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	Eventually, after a number of turns and descents, you pass through an open archway into some kind of conference room. Large and circular with a high, rounded ceiling, it is occupied by a trio of multicolored dragonfly aliens, each perched on a metal ring running around a circular table.|298|0
units.english: Eventually, after a number of turns and descents, you pass through an open archway into some kind of conference room. Large and circular with a high, rounded ceiling, it is occupied by a trio of multicolored dragonfly aliens, each perched on a metal ring running around a circular table.
units.italian: Alla fine, dopo una serie di svolte e discese, attraversi un arco aperto ed entri in una specie di sala conferenze. Ampia e circolare, con un soffitto alto e arrotondato, è occupata da tre alieni libellula variopinti, ciascuno appollaiato su un anello di metallo che corre intorno a un tavolo circolare.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"Hello."|300|0
units.english: "Hello."
units.italian: "Salve."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"Who are you?"|301|0
units.english: "Who are you?"
units.italian: "Chi siete?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	The alien directly across from you, gray-white in color, begins speaking with the aid of another of the translator devices - this time taking on a feminine voice.|302|0
units.english: The alien directly across from you, gray-white in color, begins speaking with the aid of another of the translator devices - this time taking on a feminine voice.
units.italian: L'alieno di fronte a te, di colore bianco-grigio, comincia a parlare con l'aiuto di un altro dei dispositivi traduttori, questa volta con una voce femminile.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"Invitation. I apologize for the inconvenience of traveling so far from your ship to meet us, but I was advised against being present for your arrival for fear of any unexpected hostilities, as small as such chances were estimated. My name, for lack of a direct translation, is 'Asime,' and with me are Speakers Prasinos and Galano. Together, we represent the Avgi Consonance as the First Speakers of the Assembly of Polities."|303|0
units.english: "Invitation. I apologize for the inconvenience of traveling so far from your ship to meet us, but I was advised against being present for your arrival for fear of any unexpected hostilities, as small as such chances were estimated. My name, for lack of a direct translation, is 'Asime,' and with me are Speakers Prasinos and Galano. Together, we represent the Avgi Consonance as the First Speakers of the Assembly of Polities."
units.italian: "Invito. Mi scuso per il disagio di dover viaggiare così lontano dalla tua nave per incontrarci, ma mi era stato sconsigliato di essere presente al tuo arrivo per timore di ostilità impreviste, per quanto improbabile fosse stimata una simile eventualità. Il mio nome, in mancanza di una traduzione diretta, è 'Asime', e con me ci sono i Portavoce Prasinos e Galano. Insieme rappresentiamo la Consonanza Avgi come Primi Portavoce dell'Assemblea delle Entità."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	Prasinos, grass-green in color, and Galano, a frail-looking milky-white Avgi, both wave at you with their forelimbs in a somewhat surreal imitation of the human gesture.|304|0
units.english: Prasinos, grass-green in color, and Galano, a frail-looking milky-white Avgi, both wave at you with their forelimbs in a somewhat surreal imitation of the human gesture.
units.italian: Prasinos, di colore verde erba, e Galano, un Avgi bianco latte dall'aria fragile, ti salutano agitando gli arti anteriori in un'imitazione un po' surreale del gesto umano.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"How can you speak my language?"|306|0
units.english: "How can you speak my language?"
units.italian: "Come fate a parlare la mia lingua?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"Who are those hostile aliens back toward the north?"|308|0
units.english: "Who are those hostile aliens back toward the north?"
units.italian: "Chi sono quegli alieni ostili verso nord?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"Will you tell me about your civilization?"|310|0
units.english: "Will you tell me about your civilization?"
units.italian: "Mi parlerete della vostra civiltà?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	She twitches her wings slightly in what might be laughter. "Amusement. That would take a very long time to do in any detail, but I will make an attempt." Reverting back to her own language, she consults with the two other Avgi for a minute before turning back to you.|314|0
units.english: She twitches her wings slightly in what might be laughter. "Amusement. That would take a very long time to do in any detail, but I will make an attempt." Reverting back to her own language, she consults with the two other Avgi for a minute before turning back to you.
units.italian: Agita appena le ali in quello che potrebbe essere un riso. "Divertimento. Per farlo con un minimo di dettaglio servirebbe moltissimo tempo, ma proverò." Tornando alla propria lingua, si consulta con gli altri due Avgi per un minuto prima di rivolgersi di nuovo a te.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"Pride, accomplishment. We are the Avgi. Our six systems, with seven worlds, and hundreds of orbitals each the size of a city, together a thousand polities united towards the betterment of civilization and progress-"|315|0
units.english: "Pride, accomplishment. We are the Avgi. Our six systems, with seven worlds, and hundreds of orbitals each the size of a city, together a thousand polities united towards the betterment of civilization and progress-"
units.italian: "Orgoglio, realizzazione. Noi siamo gli Avgi. I nostri sei sistemi, con sette mondi, e centinaia di orbitali grandi ciascuno come una città, insieme mille entità politiche unite per il miglioramento della civiltà e del progresso-"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	Galano interrupts, his translator's voice sounding somehow aged. "Remembrance. But before all that, before the hyperdrive, we still crossed the void between stars. I was a child when the last true starship launched, but I remember. Long before we learned to surpass light, we settled the worlds beyond our home star system, at great cost and effort. We first touched space six centuries ago, and-"|316|0
units.english: Galano interrupts, his translator's voice sounding somehow aged. "Remembrance. But before all that, before the hyperdrive, we still crossed the void between stars. I was a child when the last true starship launched, but I remember. Long before we learned to surpass light, we settled the worlds beyond our home star system, at great cost and effort. We first touched space six centuries ago, and-"
units.italian: Galano lo interrompe, e la voce del suo traduttore suona in qualche modo invecchiata. "Ricordo. Ma prima di tutto questo, prima dell'hyperdrive, attraversavamo comunque il vuoto tra le stelle. Ero un bambino quando partì l'ultima vera nave stellare, ma ricordo. Molto prima di imparare a superare la luce, abbiamo colonizzato i mondi oltre il nostro sistema natale, a caro prezzo e con grande sforzo. Abbiamo toccato lo spazio sei secoli fa, e-"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	He is cut off by Prasinos. "Rebuke. You should start from the beginning, long before we left Aviskir. Our ancestors made their homes around the springs in the valleys of the Fel Mountains, and spread across our planet for millennia. From fire to spears to the atom, our skill in turning the natural world to our will grew, and with it our ability to form civilization: groups of Avgi bound together by more than close kinship or geography, instead by ideology and heritage and religion. And with that came conflict, each polity striving with the others to-"|317|0
units.english: He is cut off by Prasinos. "Rebuke. You should start from the beginning, long before we left Aviskir. Our ancestors made their homes around the springs in the valleys of the Fel Mountains, and spread across our planet for millennia. From fire to spears to the atom, our skill in turning the natural world to our will grew, and with it our ability to form civilization: groups of Avgi bound together by more than close kinship or geography, instead by ideology and heritage and religion. And with that came conflict, each polity striving with the others to-"
units.italian: Viene interrotto da Prasinos. "Rimprovero. Dovresti cominciare dall'inizio, molto prima che lasciassimo Aviskir. I nostri antenati si stabilirono intorno alle sorgenti delle valli dei Monti Fel e si diffusero sul pianeta per millenni. Dal fuoco alle lance all'atomo, la nostra abilità di piegare il mondo naturale alla nostra volontà crebbe, e con essa la capacità di formare una civiltà: gruppi di Avgi legati non dalla vicinanza di sangue o dalla geografia, ma da ideologia, eredità e religione. E con questo venne il conflitto, ogni entità politica in lotta con le altre per-"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	Now both Asime and Galano make noises of dissent, and Galano, sounding rather hurried, interrupts. "Urgency. Perhaps we are not as united as you, the humans, and it is true that we have fought many wars among ourselves. Emphasis. But that time is long since past. We saw reason, and so the Consonance was created, governed by an Assembly of Polities to represent every division of the Avgi, small or large. From the nation-states to the ideolopoli, a consensus government of our species to resolve disputes, to prevent another Great War. And while there have still been wars fought by the foolish and shortsighted, there has not been a nuclear initiation on Aviskir's surface in more than a century. The Assembly, for all its faults, works."|318|0
units.english: Now both Asime and Galano make noises of dissent, and Galano, sounding rather hurried, interrupts. "Urgency. Perhaps we are not as united as you, the humans, and it is true that we have fought many wars among ourselves. Emphasis. But that time is long since past. We saw reason, and so the Consonance was created, governed by an Assembly of Polities to represent every division of the Avgi, small or large. From the nation-states to the ideolopoli, a consensus government of our species to resolve disputes, to prevent another Great War. And while there have still been wars fought by the foolish and shortsighted, there has not been a nuclear initiation on Aviskir's surface in more than a century. The Assembly, for all its faults, works."
units.italian: Ora sia Asime sia Galano emettono suoni di dissenso, e Galano, con voce piuttosto affrettata, interviene. "Urgenza. Forse non siamo uniti come voi umani, ed è vero che abbiamo combattuto molte guerre tra noi. Enfasi. Ma quel tempo è passato da un pezzo. Abbiamo visto la ragione, e così nacque la Consonanza, governata da un'Assemblea delle Entità che rappresenta ogni divisione degli Avgi, piccola o grande. Dagli stati-nazione agli ideolopoli, un governo consensuale della nostra specie per risolvere le dispute, per evitare un'altra Grande Guerra. E benché sciocchi e miopi abbiano continuato a combattere guerre, da oltre un secolo non c'è più stata un'iniziazione nucleare sulla superficie di Aviskir. L'Assemblea, con tutti i suoi difetti, funziona."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	Asime adds, "Truth. And we are what the Avgi need, now that all of that could be lost to the Incursion, to the Aberrant it spawned. We need what humanity has, a united Republic to lead all of our people."|319|0
units.english: Asime adds, "Truth. And we are what the Avgi need, now that all of that could be lost to the Incursion, to the Aberrant it spawned. We need what humanity has, a united Republic to lead all of our people."
units.italian: Asime aggiunge: "Verità. E noi siamo ciò di cui gli Avgi hanno bisogno, ora che tutto questo potrebbe andare perduto per l'Incursione, per gli Aberranti che ha generato. Ci serve ciò che l'umanità ha: una Repubblica unita che guidi tutto il nostro popolo."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"How do you know of humanity?"|321|0
units.english: "How do you know of humanity?"
units.italian: "Come fate a sapere dell'umanità?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"What are the Aberrant?"|325|0
units.english: "What are the Aberrant?"
units.italian: "Cosa sono gli Aberranti?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"That's all the questions I have. What happens now?"|329|0
units.english: "That's all the questions I have. What happens now?"
units.italian: "Ho finito le domande. E ora cosa succede?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	Prasinos thinks for a moment, then says, "Hesitance. It may come as a surprise to you, but you are not the first human to come to our space. Three- no, that would be six of your years ago, an alien ship was found drifting around a star in our space, swarmed by Aberrations. By some miracle they were driven away, and the ship recovered. And those were the first, and until now, the only humans we have had the honor of meeting. A crew of explorers from, I believe they said, 'the depths,' though I am not quite sure if that is a planet or a region of space."|335|0
units.english: Prasinos thinks for a moment, then says, "Hesitance. It may come as a surprise to you, but you are not the first human to come to our space. Three- no, that would be six of your years ago, an alien ship was found drifting around a star in our space, swarmed by Aberrations. By some miracle they were driven away, and the ship recovered. And those were the first, and until now, the only humans we have had the honor of meeting. A crew of explorers from, I believe they said, 'the depths,' though I am not quite sure if that is a planet or a region of space."
units.italian: Prasinos riflette un momento, poi dice: "Esitazione. Potrebbe sorprenderti, ma non sei il primo umano ad arrivare nel nostro spazio. Tre- no, sarebbero sei dei vostri anni fa, una nave aliena fu trovata alla deriva intorno a una stella del nostro spazio, circondata dagli Aberranti. Per qualche miracolo furono respinti e la nave recuperata. E quelli furono i primi, e fino a ora gli unici umani che abbiamo avuto l'onore di incontrare. Un equipaggio di esploratori da, credo abbiano detto, 'le profondità', anche se non sono del tutto sicura se sia un pianeta o una regione di spazio."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"Appreciation. They have told us much of humanity, and developed these devices so as to allow us to more easily communicate. And without the ability to return home, they now live among us, helping where they can with their knowledge of humanity's advanced technologies."|336|0
units.english: "Appreciation. They have told us much of humanity, and developed these devices so as to allow us to more easily communicate. And without the ability to return home, they now live among us, helping where they can with their knowledge of humanity's advanced technologies."
units.italian: "Riconoscenza. Ci hanno raccontato molto dell'umanità e hanno sviluppato questi dispositivi per permetterci di comunicare più facilmente. E, non potendo tornare a casa, ora vivono tra noi, aiutando dove possono con la loro conoscenza delle tecnologie avanzate dell'umanità."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|label|337|0
units.english: human questions
units.italian: human questions

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"What are these 'Aberrations?'"|339|0
units.english: "What are these 'Aberrations?'"
units.italian: "Cosa sono queste 'Aberrazioni'?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"Tell me more about the Avgi."|343|0
units.english: "Tell me more about the Avgi."
units.italian: "Dimmi di più sugli Avgi."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"I don't know if I'd call human technology advanced."|347|0
units.english: "I don't know if I'd call human technology advanced."
units.italian: "Non so se definirei avanzata la tecnologia umana."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"That's all the questions I have. I'd like to meet these humans."|351|0
units.english: "That's all the questions I have. I'd like to meet these humans."
units.italian: "Ho finito le domande. Vorrei incontrare questi umani."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	Galano speaks. "Appreciation. Perhaps not to you, but humanity has had the hyperdrive since long before we reached our homeworld's moon. I have seen the changes and advancements even a handful of decades can bring, and your species' advantage over us of centuries has brought you miracles such as shields and repulsors."|357|0
units.english: Galano speaks. "Appreciation. Perhaps not to you, but humanity has had the hyperdrive since long before we reached our homeworld's moon. I have seen the changes and advancements even a handful of decades can bring, and your species' advantage over us of centuries has brought you miracles such as shields and repulsors."
units.italian: Parla Galano. "Riconoscenza. Forse non ai tuoi occhi, ma l'umanità possiede l'hyperdrive da molto prima che noi raggiungessimo la luna del nostro mondo natale. Ho visto i cambiamenti e i progressi che possono portare anche solo pochi decenni, e il vantaggio di secoli della vostra specie vi ha dato miracoli come gli scudi e i repulsori."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	Galano speaks. "Sorrow. The Aberrant, as we call them, remain enigmatic despite all they have taken from us. From where they came, we are not completely certain. They came two decades ago, from the east, beyond the reach of our knowledge, from a perilous region of space we have found difficult to probe. The scouts and explorers on the fringes of known space went dark first, and then the outposts fell one by one."|363|0
units.english: Galano speaks. "Sorrow. The Aberrant, as we call them, remain enigmatic despite all they have taken from us. From where they came, we are not completely certain. They came two decades ago, from the east, beyond the reach of our knowledge, from a perilous region of space we have found difficult to probe. The scouts and explorers on the fringes of known space went dark first, and then the outposts fell one by one."
units.italian: Parla Galano. "Dolore. Gli Aberranti, come li chiamiamo, restano enigmatici nonostante tutto ciò che ci hanno tolto. Da dove vengano non ne siamo del tutto certi. Sono arrivati due decenni fa, da est, oltre i limiti della nostra conoscenza, da una regione di spazio pericolosa che abbiamo trovato difficile da sondare. Prima sono scomparse le navi esploratrici ai margini dello spazio conosciuto, poi gli avamposti sono caduti uno dopo l'altro."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	Asime continues. "Regret. By the time the Consonance finally took note, the Aberrant swept away the ships Aviskir's polities were able to gather to oppose them. An entire generation of the Twilight Guard, wiped away in a single battle. Their technology is far beyond our own, and at the time it was impossible to oppose them. And the few Aberrations we were able to destroy baffled us. No crew, just a single organic entity inside. And systems operating on principles unknown to us. It can be said that we learned how to make shields from humanity, but we first learned what shields could do from the Aberrant."|364|0
units.english: Asime continues. "Regret. By the time the Consonance finally took note, the Aberrant swept away the ships Aviskir's polities were able to gather to oppose them. An entire generation of the Twilight Guard, wiped away in a single battle. Their technology is far beyond our own, and at the time it was impossible to oppose them. And the few Aberrations we were able to destroy baffled us. No crew, just a single organic entity inside. And systems operating on principles unknown to us. It can be said that we learned how to make shields from humanity, but we first learned what shields could do from the Aberrant."
units.italian: Asime continua. "Rincrescimento. Quando la Consonanza se ne accorse, gli Aberranti avevano già spazzato via le navi che le entità politiche di Aviskir erano riuscite a radunare per contrastarli. Un'intera generazione della Twilight Guard, cancellata in una sola battaglia. La loro tecnologia è molto al di là della nostra e allora era impossibile opporvisi. E le poche Aberrazioni che siamo riusciti a distruggere ci hanno sconcertato: nessun equipaggio, solo un'unica entità organica all'interno. E sistemi che funzionano su principi a noi ignoti. Si può dire che abbiamo imparato dall'umanità come si costruiscono gli scudi, ma abbiamo imparato dagli Aberranti cosa possono fare gli scudi."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	Prasinos says, "Anger. And thus we find ourselves here. When the hopelessness of the military situation became evident, every ship with a hyperdrive was ordered to take on passengers and make its way into the Tangled Shroud - this confusing web of broken starways and shadowed space that we now must call home. We abandoned our planets to the mercy of the Aberrant with little more than their surface defenses, scavenging the orbital infrastructure that had been painstakingly built over the centuries."|365|0
units.english: Prasinos says, "Anger. And thus we find ourselves here. When the hopelessness of the military situation became evident, every ship with a hyperdrive was ordered to take on passengers and make its way into the Tangled Shroud - this confusing web of broken starways and shadowed space that we now must call home. We abandoned our planets to the mercy of the Aberrant with little more than their surface defenses, scavenging the orbital infrastructure that had been painstakingly built over the centuries."
units.italian: Prasinos dice: "Rabbia. E così ci ritroviamo qui. Quando l'impossibilità della situazione militare divenne evidente, a ogni nave con un hyperdrive fu ordinato di imbarcare passeggeri e dirigersi nel Tangled Shroud - questa rete confusa di vie stellari spezzate e spazio in ombra che ora dobbiamo chiamare casa. Abbiamo abbandonato i nostri pianeti alla mercé degli Aberranti con poco più delle loro difese di superficie, saccheggiando l'infrastruttura orbitale costruita con tanta fatica nel corso dei secoli."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	He is interrupted by Asime, who seems annoyed. "Clarification. We were not heartless. The decision to evacuate was only made once it became evident the Aberrant had little interest in orbital bombardment, and that our surface batteries could drive off the ones that did. And we took tens of millions of civilians with us, in cryosleep, to be revived as resources allow."|366|0
units.english: He is interrupted by Asime, who seems annoyed. "Clarification. We were not heartless. The decision to evacuate was only made once it became evident the Aberrant had little interest in orbital bombardment, and that our surface batteries could drive off the ones that did. And we took tens of millions of civilians with us, in cryosleep, to be revived as resources allow."
units.italian: Lo interrompe Asime, che sembra infastidita. "Chiarimento. Non siamo stati senza cuore. La decisione di evacuare fu presa solo quando divenne evidente che gli Aberranti avevano scarso interesse per il bombardamento orbitale e che le nostre batterie di superficie potevano respingere quelli che lo tentavano. E abbiamo portato con noi decine di milioni di civili, in criosonno, da risvegliare man mano che le risorse lo consentono."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"Resolve. We will return. We have suffered a defeat, yes, but we will reclaim our systems in the end," says Galano with finality. The others do not dispute this.|367|0
units.english: "Resolve. We will return. We have suffered a defeat, yes, but we will reclaim our systems in the end," says Galano with finality. The others do not dispute this.
units.italian: "Determinazione. Torneremo. Abbiamo subito una sconfitta, sì, ma alla fine riprenderemo i nostri sistemi", dice Galano con fermezza. Gli altri non obiettano.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"How do you know my language?"|369|0
units.english: "How do you know my language?"
units.italian: "Come fate a conoscere la mia lingua?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"Tell me more about the Avgi."|373|0
units.english: "Tell me more about the Avgi."
units.italian: "Dimmi di più sugli Avgi."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"That's all the questions I have. What happens now?"|377|0
units.english: "That's all the questions I have. What happens now?"
units.italian: "Ho finito le domande. E ora cosa succede?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	Prasinos says, "Assurance. Of course, we will introduce your fellow humans to you. But..." he trails off.|381|0
units.english: Prasinos says, "Assurance. Of course, we will introduce your fellow humans to you. But..." he trails off.
units.italian: Prasinos dice: "Rassicurazione. Naturalmente ti presenteremo i tuoi simili umani. Ma..." e si interrompe.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	Asime continues for him. "Apprehension. The humans that came here before you, I must confess are still here for a reason. Perhaps they can give more details, but they have told us that when they first entered our space, they immediately attempted to leave. For whatever reason, they were unable to. I do not know the means by which you were able to travel to our space, but perhaps you will be able to return, and take these stranded humans with you."|382|0
units.english: Asime continues for him. "Apprehension. The humans that came here before you, I must confess are still here for a reason. Perhaps they can give more details, but they have told us that when they first entered our space, they immediately attempted to leave. For whatever reason, they were unable to. I do not know the means by which you were able to travel to our space, but perhaps you will be able to return, and take these stranded humans with you."
units.italian: Asime parla al posto suo. "Apprensione. Gli umani arrivati prima di te, devo confessarlo, sono ancora qui per un motivo. Forse potranno darti più dettagli, ma ci hanno detto che, appena entrati nel nostro spazio, hanno subito tentato di andarsene. Per qualche ragione non ci sono riusciti. Non so in che modo tu sia riuscito a viaggiare fino al nostro spazio, ma forse riuscirai a tornare, portando via con te questi umani bloccati."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"Or, you may find yourself trapped here, just as they are. In any case, we will of course make you as comfortable as we can, as an honored guest, and treat you as we would any foreign dignitary."|383|0
units.english: "Or, you may find yourself trapped here, just as they are. In any case, we will of course make you as comfortable as we can, as an honored guest, and treat you as we would any foreign dignitary."
units.italian: "Oppure potresti scoprirti bloccato qui, proprio come loro. In ogni caso, naturalmente faremo il possibile per il tuo comfort, come ospite onorato, e ti tratteremo come qualunque dignitario straniero."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"I have a jump drive that lets me travel beyond the hyperlanes, but it won't let me jump back to human space."|385|0
units.english: "I have a jump drive that lets me travel beyond the hyperlanes, but it won't let me jump back to human space."
units.italian: "Ho un motore di salto che mi permette di viaggiare oltre le ipervie, ma non mi consente di saltare indietro nello spazio umano."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"I have a device that lets me go where I please, but it isn't working at the moment."|386|0
units.english: "I have a device that lets me go where I please, but it isn't working at the moment."
units.italian: "Ho un dispositivo che mi permette di andare dove voglio, ma al momento non funziona."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"Regret. Then the situation is most unfortunate," she says. "Commitment. We will offer you what help we can, but I did not wish to lie to you about their predicament, or provide you with false hope."|388|0
units.english: "Regret. Then the situation is most unfortunate," she says. "Commitment. We will offer you what help we can, but I did not wish to lie to you about their predicament, or provide you with false hope."
units.italian: "Rincrescimento. Allora la situazione è davvero spiacevole", dice lei. "Impegno. Ti offriremo l'aiuto che possiamo, ma non volevo mentirti sulla loro condizione, né darti false speranze."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"Reservation. Perhaps Captain <last> will be able to find a solution." says Galano. "I would not dismiss the possibility too quickly."|389|0
units.english: "Reservation. Perhaps Captain <last> will be able to find a solution." says Galano. "I would not dismiss the possibility too quickly."
units.italian: "Riserva. Forse il capitano <last> riuscirà a trovare una soluzione", dice Galano. "Non liquiderei la possibilità troppo in fretta."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"While I'm here, can I buy your technology?"|391|0
units.english: "While I'm here, can I buy your technology?"
units.italian: "Finché sono qui, posso comprare la vostra tecnologia?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"Is there anything I can do to help in the meantime?"|393|0
units.english: "Is there anything I can do to help in the meantime?"
units.italian: "C'è qualcosa che posso fare per aiutare nel frattempo?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"Consideration. As an alien, you will inevitably be a novelty to most of us, but the existence of humans is well-known among the public enough for you to walk among us without issue. I will speak to others about a more formal role, but until then I am unsure if we can ask anything of you beyond keeping the peace."|395|0
units.english: "Consideration. As an alien, you will inevitably be a novelty to most of us, but the existence of humans is well-known among the public enough for you to walk among us without issue. I will speak to others about a more formal role, but until then I am unsure if we can ask anything of you beyond keeping the peace."
units.italian: "Considerazione. Come alieno sarai inevitabilmente una novità per la maggior parte di noi, ma l'esistenza degli umani è abbastanza nota al pubblico perché tu possa camminare tra noi senza problemi. Parlerò con altri di un ruolo più formale, ma fino ad allora non so se possiamo chiederti altro che mantenere la pace."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|label|396|0
units.english: buy stuff
units.italian: buy stuff

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	Galano says, "Interest. I would expect human technology to be superior to our own in most aspects, but we will of course allow you to purchase our items with the agreement of the Assembly. In the event that it becomes possible to open trade relations with your human government, we may find it useful to have prior transactions."|397|0
units.english: Galano says, "Interest. I would expect human technology to be superior to our own in most aspects, but we will of course allow you to purchase our items with the agreement of the Assembly. In the event that it becomes possible to open trade relations with your human government, we may find it useful to have prior transactions."
units.italian: Galano dice: "Interesse. Mi aspetterei che la tecnologia umana sia superiore alla nostra sotto molti aspetti, ma naturalmente ti permetteremo di acquistare i nostri prodotti con l'accordo dell'Assemblea. Nel caso diventasse possibile aprire relazioni commerciali con il vostro governo umano, potremmo trovare utile avere transazioni precedenti."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	"Amusement. Not to mention the goodwill such a gesture could buy us," says Asime.|398|0
units.english: "Amusement. Not to mention the goodwill such a gesture could buy us," says Asime.
units.italian: "Divertimento. Per non parlare della benevolenza che un gesto simile potrebbe procurarci", dice Asime.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	Prasinos says, more seriously, "Reservation. Our material resources are quite limited at the moment, so for now I would only support providing for the requisition of small items that do not strain the needs of the Guard."|399|0
units.english: Prasinos says, more seriously, "Reservation. Our material resources are quite limited at the moment, so for now I would only support providing for the requisition of small items that do not strain the needs of the Guard."
units.italian: Prasinos dice, più seriamente: "Riserva. Le nostre risorse materiali sono piuttosto limitate al momento, quindi per ora sosterrei soltanto la richiesta di piccoli articoli che non mettano in difficoltà le necessità della Guardia."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	Asime looks like she wants to object, but then Galano says, "Agreement. A reasonable compromise, one I can sell to the Assembly fairly easily. Beyond that, we will provide you with a line of credit with which to purchase housing and nutrition. I cannot vouch for its usefulness among... certain elements that do not recognize the authority of Consonance, but anywhere else, you should find no issues."|400|0
units.english: Asime looks like she wants to object, but then Galano says, "Agreement. A reasonable compromise, one I can sell to the Assembly fairly easily. Beyond that, we will provide you with a line of credit with which to purchase housing and nutrition. I cannot vouch for its usefulness among... certain elements that do not recognize the authority of Consonance, but anywhere else, you should find no issues."
units.italian: Asime sembra voler obiettare, ma poi Galano dice: "Accordo. Un compromesso ragionevole, che posso vendere all'Assemblea con una certa facilità. Oltre a questo, ti forniremo una linea di credito con cui acquistare alloggio e nutrimento. Non posso garantire la sua utilità tra... certi elementi che non riconoscono l'autorità della Consonanza, ma altrove non dovresti avere problemi."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	He twitches his wings. "Satisfaction. For now, we will leave you with some time and space to think. The former captain of the ship that brought the other humans, one Darius Calwell, is currently advising construction on the cylinder habitat in this system. You will find him on Aktina Cylinder, if you wish to speak with him. And should you wish to speak to us as well, there is one last gift we will bestow upon you today that will facilitate that."|401|0
units.english: He twitches his wings. "Satisfaction. For now, we will leave you with some time and space to think. The former captain of the ship that brought the other humans, one Darius Calwell, is currently advising construction on the cylinder habitat in this system. You will find him on Aktina Cylinder, if you wish to speak with him. And should you wish to speak to us as well, there is one last gift we will bestow upon you today that will facilitate that."
units.italian: Agita le ali. "Soddisfazione. Per ora ti lasceremo un po' di tempo e di spazio per riflettere. L'ex capitano della nave che ha portato gli altri umani, un certo Darius Calwell, al momento segue la costruzione dell'habitat cilindrico in questo sistema. Lo troverai sul Cilindro Aktina, se vuoi parlargli. E se vorrai parlare anche con noi, c'è un ultimo dono che ti faremo oggi per facilitare le cose."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Humans From the Deep|	Before you are dismissed, he holds out a long arm, with a black hairpin-shaped rod clutched between his three sharp fingers, like a smaller version of the translator the Avgi have been using to communicate with you. Tucked behind your ear, this device will translate the speech of the most common Avgi languages as is it spoken around you, quietly whispering the meaning into your ear.|402|0
units.english: Before you are dismissed, he holds out a long arm, with a black hairpin-shaped rod clutched between his three sharp fingers, like a smaller version of the translator the Avgi have been using to communicate with you. Tucked behind your ear, this device will translate the speech of the most common Avgi languages as is it spoken around you, quietly whispering the meaning into your ear.
units.italian: Prima che tu sia congedato, tende un lungo braccio, con una bacchetta nera a forma di forcina stretta tra le tre dita affilate, come una versione più piccola del traduttore che gli Avgi usano per comunicare con te. Infilato dietro l'orecchio, questo dispositivo tradurrà le lingue Avgi più diffuse man mano che vengono parlate intorno a te, sussurrandoti il significato all'orecchio.
